prompt:
A rigid steel cylinder of volume 0.0350 m^3 contains 140 mol of nitrogen gas at a temperature of 20.0 °C. Take R = 8.31 J K^-1 mol^-1.
(a) Convert 20.0 °C into kelvin. [1]
(b) Calculate the pressure of the nitrogen gas in the cylinder. [2]
hints: In (b), rearrange pV = nRT to make p the subject.
teacher_walkthrough: Step (b) verifies algebraic substitution and large-magnitude pressure handling (megapascals).

provenance.abstract_pattern: structured pV = nRT pressure calculation from cylinder volume and moles
provenance.independence_statement: Authored as an original medium question on industrial gas cylinder pressure.
